name: SNN Estates Felicity
address: Railway Parallel Road, Mestri Palya, Rachenahalli/Jakkur, behind Manyata Business Park, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: SNN Estates Felicity is an apartment community behind the Manyata employment area, offering formats from 1.5 to four bedrooms. The developer describes a 6-acre-and-20-gunta site, with recreation built around its Happiness Club and shared indoor and outdoor facilities. Miyawaki-inspired landscaping, a festive activity lane and varied window and balcony treatments give the project its character.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about SNN Estates Felicity

faqs.question: Where exactly is SNN Estates Felicity located?
faqs.answer: Railway Parallel Road, Mestri Palya, Rachenahalli/Jakkur, behind Manyata Business Park, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560064. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 1.5 BHK (with additional flexible room), 2 BHK, 2.5 BHK (with additional flexible room), 3 BHK, 4 BHK. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 700–2300 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹93.5 L* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: December 2028, CP reference. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming pool, Basketball court, Children’s play area, Cricket practice pitch, Skating rink, Yoga and meditation space. 50,000 sq ft is a facilities-area claim, not an amenity count. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Six acres and 20 guntas 1.5 2 2.5 3 and 4 BHK formats 50000 sq ft of facilities in the developer description. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
